reviews.text: Don’t download this app. I downloaded this app because it looked interesting. It looked like there was a free version with the option to unlock functions with in-app purchases. When the app starts it takes you through 15-20 questions and then immediately takes you to a pay screen with an option for a brief free trial. I had no intention on paying for a subscription so I immediately closed and deleted the app without choosing options. Three days later I got billed for a year subscription. I never chose this and Apple says it’s not eligible for a refund. The app may work well. I’m not sure because I never used it and never even saw the user interface screen. It’s a really unfair business practice and unfair for Apple to allow this to happen. It’s just a sneaky trick to grab your money. Now I’m stuck with a nonrefundable app that I never even used. Total garbage and totally unfair. Just a one star scam.

I really like the concept and the AI food recognition is excellent, but there are two major issues that significantly reduce the app’s usefulness.

1. Apple Health integration doesn’t work correctly. Even with all Health permissions enabled, Cal AI does not write nutrition data (calories, carbohydrates, sugar, etc.) to Apple Health. Water sync may work, but food data is simply not transferred.

2. Personalization Preferences are broken. Changing the personalization settings has no visible effect on recommendations or behavior, making the feature feel non-functional.
